apps.name: GrandStand
apps.subtitle: Live sport, TV, movies and replays
apps.localizedDescription: Live sport from every source in one place, free-to-air and sports channels, Twitch, full-game replays, and movies and TV shows (with a TorBox account).

versions.localizedDescription: Live TV: almost every channel now shows its logo and what's on now and next, including Fox Sports 507, beIN Sports 1-3 and all the Sky Sport NZ channels. Around 60 more English channels added (Nat Geo, Animal Planet, Science, Travel, TSN, NFL RedZone, Willow, Nick, Sky Atlantic and more), and more foreign-language channels filtered out.

New Live TV: browse channels by country (Australia, NZ, USA, UK, Canada) and category (Sport, News, Movies and more), each with its logo and what's on now. Hundreds of extra US/UK channels, all playing here with no VPN. Favourite channels by pressing and holding, with a Favourites filter. Also: no more 'Skip recap' on a show's first episode, remove Twitch channels by holding, and smoother channel playback.
